// RED probe — rule 3 (the identity-pair composition policyLabel() owns).
// The shape notifications/actions.ts shipped: "Insurer (Number)" hand-built
// from the raw columns, outside any el/en key and with no Greek on the line.
export function probe(p: { insurerName: string; policyNumber: string }) {
    const e: { related_policy_name: string | null } = { related_policy_name: null }
    e.related_policy_name = `${p.insurerName} (${p.policyNumber})`
    return e
}
